A '''Corellian''' founded the [[Beharen Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and lived in a [[Unidentified Coronet high-rise|high-rise]] tower in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Unidentified Imperial warship|damaged Imperial warship]] clipped the tower, collapsing several floors&mdash;with the founder's residence among them. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the chaos, though initial recovery efforts failed to locate his body among the rubble.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The founder of the Beharen Droid Factory was mentioned in the Codex entry for the factory in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
